identification: One long strapped pack of solid Tasmanian oak tongue and groove flooring on bearers, handwritten batten 'APPROX 8.0 M2 TAS OAK T+G FLOORING'. End view shows only about 3 boards across by about 17 layers, and the boards look roughly 4.5-5 times their thickness, so probably about 85-90 x 19-20 mm, not the 65 x 20 mm in the catalogue. Long lengths (pack roughly 4-5 m against the forklift), some shorter pieces sticking out one end. Unfinished, appears unused; several darker or weathered boards and a few rough/grey ends. Illegible pencil writing on the top board.
